area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: The app opens on the list of chats, with one chat: Will
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: someone signs up whom nobody invited
then: the list shows Will, pinned on top, with his three-dot mark
under it, “Add someone to chat with”, and the round +
before the chat is set up, + shows “Before you share your link, set the questions for people who join.” with “Set them”
note: The list is the app's own. Will's first line for someone nobody invited is drafted.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Will asks what you do, and you type it in Will's chat
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person opens Will and taps “Let's start”
then: the box opens in Will's chat and the person types their work
Will works out what fits that work: the choices on every later screen
nothing is copied from another person's chat
note: On main the setup still starts a new host from Artur's five questions (starting_questions); N612 item 2 says it starts blank.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: One decision per screen: Keep or Change
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: Will has suggestions for this person
then: it shows one line from Will, one thing, and two buttons: Change and Keep
Change shows Will's next suggestion
“Type my own” goes to Will's chat for the words and comes back to the same screen

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: What people send: tick all that apply
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches what people send
then: a recording, a message, a photo, a file, each with a tick; Will's first suggestion comes ticked
several can be ticked; Done keeps them
note: A recording and a typed message exist; a photo is in backend #1880; a file is not built.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: What they get back is the chat's own output
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches what people get back
then: asked only when Will's suggestion is not simply an answer (for a speaking coach: their own words, tidied)
otherwise people get an answer, and the host can change it from their chat's parts

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: The hello, the first questions and what people can tap
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches the chat's first lines
then: the hello, then up to three first questions, one at a time, with “Ask one more question?”
three taps people can ask with, and “Something else” always there (N604)
a host's own words pass the same checks as Will's (no score, no verdict)
note: The recipe keeps the welcome, the questions and how people answer (#1856). The taps as question types are not built.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: A model is one question with three answers
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches the models
then: the card shows one question and its three answers
Change shows another; “Type my own” takes the person's own question, then one of three sets of answers
a model that already exists and fits what people send is offered first, with its price in tokens, paid by the host
note: Starting a model is backend #1867, in the merge queue; adding someone's model to your chat is not built.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: You teach it, then it guesses and you check
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person kept a model
then: the person answers the model's question on examples (10 in the app)
then the model guesses first and the person taps Keep, or Change and the right answer
each answer and each fix teaches the model

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Who answers: the shadow, only you, or your assistant
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches who answers
then: “I draft the answer. You check it and send it.” comes first
Change: “Only you answer. I stay quiet.”, then “I answer at once. You correct me.”
the assistant answers by itself only after its minimum (N606)
note: The shadow and the assistant exist for a host's chat; the minimum is not built.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Sharing a model, and its price in tokens
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person has a model of their own
when: Will asks “Let others use your models?”
then: Yes asks the price per use, in tokens; Not now keeps it private
tokens come from the existing top-up; earned tokens are credited to spend in the app; nothing pays out in money
note: The price, the split and the crediting are backend #1866, in the merge queue.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: See it as your people do, then open it
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: every part is decided
then: the chat plays one screen at a time as someone who came to it: the hello, the first questions, what they send, what they get back, each model's line, “Was this useful?”
“Open your chat to people?” Yes makes it live; Not yet keeps it saved
Will's chat then shows the link to the chat's parts, each open to change
note: “Was this useful?” is drawn, not decided.

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Something that doesn't exist yet goes on the wish list
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person asks for a piece the app doesn't have
when: they type it in Will's chat
then: Will says it isn't available yet
the wish is kept and emailed to the founder as a design element request

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Models you can use, each with its owner's price
prototype: Jump to… A second person sets up: models to choose from, and what it costs
given: models other people shared exist
then: one list shows each model: its question, its three answers, who made it, and its price per use as its owner set it
a model that does not fit what this host's people send is greyed out and says what it needs
“Make my own” is at the bottom

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: What your chat costs you
prototype: Jump to… A second person sets up: models to choose from, and what it costs
given: the host has chosen their models
then: each model is listed with its cost: its owner's price per use, or Free for the host's own
the host types how many people and how often each sends; the month's total follows
with only the host's own models: “Your chat costs you nothing.”; everything in tokens

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Health, law or money is asked once
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a host is setting up
when: Will asks whether the chat is about health, law or money
then: one yes-or-no question; in doubt, yes
with yes, the host's models only suggest to the host and never answer a person themselves

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: A new host starts blank
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: someone starts the setup
then: nothing is copied from Artur's chat or anyone else's
the choices come from what this person said they do; with no provider answer, from rules

title: The host's hello and first questions
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a person opens a host's link and joins
when: their chat with the host opens
then: the host's own hello is the first line
then the host's first questions, one at a time
the host's taps under “Tell me what you'd like to do, and I'll show you where.”, with “Something else”

title: The bar follows what the host takes
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the host ticked what people send
when: the person is about to send something
then: a recording: the black button; a message: the box; both: the box with the record button; a photo: “Add a photo”
the bar is the locked two places, never grey

title: They get back the output the host chose
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person sent something
then: an answer, their own words tidied, or what to do next, as the host chose
it says who it is from: the host, or “{name}'s assistant” with its mark

title: Each model's line names whose model it is
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the host's chat has models
then: one line per model, in the host's order
under each: the model's name and whose it is
words only: no score and no number about the person

title: “Was this useful?” never blocks the next one
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the person read what came back
then: “Was this useful?” with Yes, No and Skip
any of the three, or none, and the bar is ready for the next thing
the answer is kept with what the person did next

title: Before the minimum, the question waits for the host
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the host's assistant has fewer than 20 of the host's own answers
then: nothing is answered for the host
the question is in the host's Will; the host answers it themself

title: In a health, law or money chat the model only suggests to the host
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the host answered yes to health, law or money
then: the person gets nothing from a model
the host sees the model's suggestion in their Will and sends their own answer

title: Settled answers train a small head on a shared reader
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a model with a question and three answers has settled answers
then: each example is read once by the shared reader for its kind (voice or text)
one small head per model is fitted on the settled answers only
an exam example, a private example of another model and a withdrawn person's example are never read

title: The model's answer comes from its head
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a model has a trained head
when: it is asked about a new example
then: the answer is one of its three answers, from the head
“sure” comes from the head's own measured confidence, never from a general model's claim

title: The owner's check is ten unseen examples
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the owner answered the first 10
then: ten examples the model has not seen are shown, the model's guess first
the owner taps Keep or Change on each
none of the first 10 is among them

title: Two gates
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a model passed its owner's check
then: it may answer in its owner's chat
it cannot be shared for tokens or sold until it passes the full exam

title: A version is scored on the exam by the app
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a new version is trained
then: its exam result is computed on the exam examples, with the sign test against the version before
nobody can enter “passed” by hand

title: No photo model is offered
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a host's people send photos
then: no model that reads a photo is offered
the host sees the photo and answers

title: An exam example, or your own, cannot be answered
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a teacher knows the id of an exam example, or added an example
when: they send an answer to it
then: the answer is refused, not stored

title: A newcomer is measured against trusted teachers only
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: two new teachers answer the same examples
then: neither is admitted on the other's answers

title: Turning the training yes off reaches every model
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a person's Takes are examples in more than twenty models
when: they turn the training yes off
then: their examples leave every model at the next run

title: Counts read every row
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a model has more than a thousand answers
then: every answer is counted

title: Each model's exam has its own people
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the same person's Takes reach two models
when: each model sets its exam aside
then: being in one model's exam does not put them in the other's
a moment sealed in one model's exam is not served to the same teacher in another model

title: A version knows what it learned from
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a version is recorded
when: a person's data is deleted or withdrawn
then: every version that learned from it is found and marked to retrain

title: A paid answer is charged once
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a buyer's call is retried with the same key
then: one charge, one answer

title: The monthly limit cannot be raced
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: two answers arrive at once at the limit's edge
then: only one passes

title: Invited after going public does not open private examples
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a model went public
when: the owner invites a teacher afterwards
then: that teacher is not sent the examples that were private before

title: A host pays when someone else's model runs in their chat
prototype: Jump to… A second person sets up: models to choose from, and what it costs
given: a host's chat has another person's model
when: it runs for one of the host's people
then: the host's tokens are charged the owner's price, once
the person pays nothing and sees no price

title: Out of tokens, the model is skipped, the chat goes on
prototype: Jump to… A second person sets up: models to choose from, and what it costs
given: the host has too few tokens
then: that model's line is left out
the host is told in their Will; the person's chat is not held up
note: Drafted: what happens when the host has no tokens is not decided.

title: Earned tokens are credited every month, with no minimum
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a teacher's or an owner's model earned tokens last month
then: the tokens are credited to spend in the app
nothing is paid out in money

title: The training-yes card
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a person in a host's chat has not said the training yes
when: the host's model would learn from what they send
then: a card: “Help {name}'s model learn”, with “Yes, help it learn” and “Not now”

title: “Record Take 2” is faded until the walk is done
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a speaker has a walk not yet done
then: it is faded until the walk is done, then full black

title: A wish is one email
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a host asks for something no piece does yet
then: Will says it isn't available yet
one email reaches the founder: a design element request, with who asked and what

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: “Want to make it {profession}-smart?”
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the host's chat has its hello, questions and taps
then: Will says: “Right now your chat isn't a specialist in anything.” and asks “Want to make it {profession}-smart?”
Yes goes on; Not now leaves the chat without models and goes to who answers

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Two ways: use a model that exists, or train your own
prototype: Jump to… A second person sets up: models to choose from, and what it costs
given: the host said yes
then: “Use a model that exists”: ready now, its owner is paid a few tokens each time it runs; greyed out with “Nobody has shared one yet. Yours can be the first.” when none exists
“Train your own”: free, needs the host's answers and some time, and later others can pay to use it
the list of models says what adding one does: the chat gets a key to it, asks it each time someone sends something, and says what it found

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Your own model: what it is, when it is worth it, when it is not
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the host chose to train their own
when: before the first model is drafted
then: three short cards: what it is; worth it; not worth it
“Train my own” goes on; “Not now” goes back without a model

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Test my chat opens my own chat
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: every part is decided
then: their own chat opens under their name, like any chat in the list
what can be tapped shows as the orange bubbles of any chat; they send something and get the answer and each model's line
after the setup the list of chats holds Will and that chat

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: To change the chat, tell Will
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the host's chat is set up
when: they type “I want to edit my chat” to Will, in their own words
then: the chat's parts open again, each one tap to change

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Who answers is three plain choices on one screen
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the setup reaches who answers
then: “I draft, you send”, “Only you” and “I answer at once”, each with one line saying what follows
one tap chooses

area: The first person ever sets up a chat
title: Teach it with an example of your own
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the host is teaching a model
when: they tap “Add a photo or a file of your own”
then: their photo or file becomes the example and stays private to that model
the screen says where examples come from: what the host's people send, once they say yes to training; none is generated

title: An overlay is as wide as Will's chat
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: the app is open in a wide browser window
when: an overlay opens (AI models, the setup's screens)
then: it uses the same column as Will's chat, not a narrow strip in the middle

title: The typing box grows, and Will shows he is thinking
prototype: Jump to… The first person ever: the list of chats, then Will
given: a person types several lines, or Will is working something out
when: the text passes one line, or the wait begins
then: the box grows so the whole text shows
three dots show until Will answers
